results.note: After the 9 Nov coalition council Okamura said only that the fees will be abolished with no tax rise and that the coalition 'agreed on concrete variants' it will now refine, without naming a mechanism (the Nordic-style budget-linked variant was described by Šťastný, who does not count), and Novinky/iDNES report the final model will be presented in January.
Ukrinform on 9 Nov 07:00 GMT, citing the Air Force morning summary: 'Air defense neutralizes 271 of 317 Russian drones targeting Ukraine overnight' - 317 launched, above 160.

Interfax-Ukraine at 20:43 GMT (22:43 Kyiv) on 9 Nov: 'Ukrainian negotiating group arrived in the UAE for the trilateral meeting on Tuesday - Zelensky'; Umerov had said at ~14:30 Kyiv the delegation was en route, and Xinhua also reported both delegations' arrival at 21:47 Kyiv.

Sector taxes were not taken up at the 9 Nov coalition council (Novinky: per Juchelka and Šťastný not discussed, Okamura says possibly at the next council; Echo24: 'Sektorové daně se odkládají'), and Havlíček said only that taxing banks is 'in play' (E15), so no agreement was announced.

On 9 Nov Agriculture Minister Šebestyán defended the planned 5 CZK/m3 rise after the cabinet meeting (small users exempt) but did not say the coalition/council/leaders had agreed it; no eligible person announced a coalition agreement in reports by Seznam Zprávy, Novinky or ČT24, and the coalition council readouts do not mention water.

BFMTV, franceinfo, Le Parisien and RTL on 9 Nov: the government announced a 1.6% Smic rise brought forward to 1 December 2026 (to about 1,502 euros net), described as the first coup de pouce in about 14 years.

Les Echos (9 Nov 18:59) reports CGT general secretary Sophie Binet, leaving the social conference on Mon 9 Nov, set a new weekday national mobilisation date of 17 November, the CGT being the only one of the five main confederations calling for it at national interprofessional level; franceinfo and Yahoo/AFP headline the same day: 'La CGT appelle a une nouvelle grande journee de greve et de manifestation le 17 novembre' addressed to all employees, retirees and young people.

tagesschau.de (9 Nov) reports Merz officially presented Ilse Aigner as the Union's candidate after she addressed the CDU Bundesvorstand, and DIE ZEIT headlines 'CDU-Vorstand nominiert Ilse Aigner als Praesidentschaftskandidatin' on 9 Nov.

tagesschau.de (9 Nov) quotes Green co-leader Franziska Brantner: 'Wir sind der Ueberzeugung, dass Frau Aigner diese Rolle ausfuellen kann' and that fielding their own candidate or rejecting the Union proposal would be 'nicht die richtige Antwort'; tagesschau says the Greens have 'deutlich ihre Unterstuetzung signalisiert', but Merz said the Greens 'could join tomorrow', so a formal Green decision may still be pending. I read Brantner's statement as saying the Greens will not field their own candidate and will back Aigner.

The Finance Ministry's Cenovy vestnik 120/2026 of 9 Nov 2026 sets the maximum price of diesel ('b) nafty') for 10 Nov 2026 at 46,70 Kc s DPH per litre (petrol 41,04); CTK headline 'nafta bude pod 47 Kc' is consistent.

The NBS release list shows '2026年10月份居民消费价格同比上涨0.7%' (October 2026 CPI +0.7% y/y), dated 2026-11-09, with Google News timestamping it 9 Nov 01:30 GMT (09:30 Beijing); the English press-release page has not yet posted it.

Il Sole 24 Ore (9 Nov) reports 'UniCredit: alza guidance 2026, utile ben superiore a 11,5 mld', above July's 'well above EUR11bn'; Investing.com ('raised guidance') and Yahoo Finance Singapore ('raised 2026 guidance') report the same with the 3Q26 results of 9 Nov. UniCredit's own release page could not be read, so the article URLs come from the Google News feed.

No UKMTO/JMIC-reported merchant-vessel incident dated 9 Nov (GST) found: gCaptain's chronology (pub 2026-11-10T08:57-08:00) runs from the 7 Nov Khasab incidents and the 8 Nov JMIC advisory straight to UKMTO Warning 201-26 at 13:38 UTC on 10 Nov; Khaleej Times' 9 Nov live blog and a Google News UKMTO 4-day sweep show only 7/8 Nov and 10 Nov incidents (ukmto.org itself refuses scripted reading, 403).

Herzog tasked Eisenkot on Sun 8 Nov, but through 9 Nov JPost reports only that Yashar 'invited' Shas and UTJ to back replacing the Knesset speaker (UTJ's Asher replied by statement) and that Eisenkot met Liberman; ToI late 9 Nov says Eisenkot and Liberman only 'greenlit outreach' to the Haredim, and no in-person meeting with UTJ/Shas leaders or teams was reported by 23:59 on 9 Nov.

Interior Ministry release (2026-11-09 14:27 CET): 'Vláda dnes, 9. listopadu 2026, schválila návrh nové legislativy' on anti-drone protection of critical infrastructure prepared with the Transport Ministry; ČTK and Novinky also reported the approval and the bill heading to the Chamber.

Última Hora (2026-11-09 15:09) citing the BCP's 9 Nov post: from Monday a new group is added and 'ya empezaron a recibir su dinero aquellos clientes con deudas que tendrán la parte vencida de la deuda descontada'; ABC Color and Vanguardia reported the same start on 9 Nov.

Rubio landed in Paris on the morning of Mon 9 Nov (WPLG/ANI/Fox headlines 08:15-12:58 UTC) and Monday reports from AFP ('Europe top diplomats press Rubio on Ukraine at G7', 17:22 UTC), Reuters-based Korea Times ('G7 ministers press Rubio on Iran, Ukraine at Paris talks', 13:29 UTC) and AP describe him taking part in the Paris talks on 9 Nov; Ukrinform also reports Sybiha meeting him on the sidelines; based on headline-level reports from several outlets, as state.gov and AP refuse scripted reading.

On Mon 9 Nov around 13:00-13:20 UTC, ČTK ('Soud: Volby v Želechovicích jsou neplatné, do volební místnosti někdo vnikl'), ČT24, Novinky and iDNES reported that the court had ruled on the Želechovice complaints after the hearing that day; the election will be repeated (article pages not directly reachable; titles via Google News).

ČTK, ČT24 and Novinky reported on 9 Nov (about 13:00-13:20 UTC) that the court declared the Želechovice election invalid ('Volby v Želechovicích jsou neplatné') because someone entered the polling room; iDNES says the vote will be repeated.
